title: Fish-Heads
transcription:
Fish-Heads

Chorus:
Fish-heads, fish-heads,
rolly, polly, fish-heads.
Fish-heads, fish-heads,
eat them up, yum...

Verse-make up your own. Examples:
I take a fish-head with me to the shower,
it is better than soap on a rope.

-I took a fish-head with me to a movie,
it really stunk, and so did the fish head.

(Pretty much no wrong answers on this one,
be creative. Try substituting the word 'fish-
head' for popular songs, ie 'If I were a fish-
head' for popular songs, ie 'If I were a rich man from
Fiddler on the Roof)
notes: Draft song-level split from visual page transcription. Source page note: Draft visual transcription from a clear scan. A few words in the Sunday School verses are faint/uncertain, especially 'shove for cover' and some proper names.
